theorems.name: Submission.slicing_ru_smooth_to_continuous
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ₁ μ₂ : Measure (Eucl P)) (g₁ g₂ : Eucl P → ℝ), Integrable g₁ μ₁ → Integrable g₂ μ₂ → ∀ O : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen O → (∀ φ : Eucl P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ O → ∫ x, φ x * g₁ x ∂μ₁ = ∫ x, φ x * g₂ x ∂μ₂) → ∀ φ : Eucl P → ℝ, Continuous φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ O → ∫ x, φ x * g₁ x ∂μ₁ = ∫ x, φ x * g₂ x ∂μ₂
